title: Beyond the Click: measuring incremental lift across influencers and affiliates (host framing)
summary: Dustin hosts a panel on the "constellation strategy": pairing influencer reach with affiliate retargeting and measuring publisher-level incrementality. His own contribution is mostly framing and questions; the substantive tactics come from the panelists (Kim Murray, Annie Laro, Tom Wthbone).

principles.text: Influencer buzz alone isn't enough; brands need measurable action and a scalable growth approach.
principles.quote: in a world where influencer buzz alone isn't enough and affiliate conversions are increasingly scrutinized out there, brands need more connection, measurable action, scalable approach to growth.

principles.text: Pair influencer content distribution with affiliate retargeting to generate demand and close the loop with data.
principles.quote: This session is all about aligning influencer content distribution strategies with affiliate retargeting to not only generate demand, but to close the loop with databased performance.

principles.text: Pulling back a performance campaign for being 'too successful' makes little sense when you only pay on results.
principles.quote: some campaigns are too successful. brands say like we're paying too much for affiliate but it's on performance. That seems like ludicrous talk to me.
